qa_pair.question: A colleague writes: "The replacement SEC-HPLC column has now passed requalification." Which item should that update be posted on? Answer with its entry number, as #N.
On what date did the person assigned to the SEC-HPLC column failure item report its root cause? Answer as YYYY-MM-DD.
Among the GenSci-owned P1 actions that are overdue, take the one with the earliest due date. Who is assigned to it? Answer with the person's full name.
The SEC-HPLC column failure item was blocked at one point. What is its status now? Answer with the status value the tracker uses, such as open.
How many P1 actions that are neither completed nor cancelled have a due date on or before 2026-06-30? Answer with a number.
Who moved the SEC-HPLC column failure item from blocked to in progress? Answer with the person's full name.
How many actions, not counting notes, are in the group "Gen2 (Process 2.0) CMC"? Answer with a number.
An agent posted a weekly digest update on the SEC-HPLC column failure item. What is the name of the API token it wrote through?
Is "Formulation" a valid group in this programme? Answer True or False.
What is the due date of the only Yarrow-owned action that is in progress and is not P1? Answer as YYYY-MM-DD.
